title: 我无法通过快捷键使用文本提取器
author: GISer-Qiu
summary: Text Extractor does not activate from its keyboard shortcut, but the report gives no reproduction steps, expected behavior, configured shortcut, visible response, or diagnostic archive.

status.label: Activation evidence needed
status.detail: A focused activation comparison and fresh diagnostic archive are needed to separate shortcut conflict, disabled-module state, and Text Extractor startup failure.

next_action.label: Request Text Extractor activation details
next_action.reason: The report does not establish whether the shortcut is registered, blocked by another app, or launching Text Extractor and failing afterward.

judgment.rationale: The live issue only says the reporter cannot use Text Extractor through the shortcut and provides environment details. The Text Extractor module has a settings-driven runner hotkey path and a separate overlay process, so the missing observed behavior determines which layer to investigate.
evidence: The body lists PowerToys 0.101.2362, GitHub install, TextExtractor area, Windows NT 10.0.26200.0, .NET 10.0.11, non-elevated per-user install, and zh-Hans-HK locale.
The reproduction and expected-behavior fields contain only “无”, and no actual behavior, screenshot, comments, or diagnostic ZIP are supplied.
The timeline contains only Issue-Bug and Needs-Triage labels; there are no assignees, linked closing PRs, or maintainer comments.

Code inspection found Text Extractor shortcut parsing/defaulting in src/modules/PowerOCR/PowerOCRModuleInterface/dllmain.cpp and overlay activation under src/modules/PowerOCR/PowerOCR/Keyboard, but the issue does not identify which path fails.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the exact shortcut, observed response, Settings activation comparison, shortcut-conflict state, and a fresh diagnostic archive after reproducing.

issue_context.summary: A Text Extractor shortcut activation failure is reported, but the current issue lacks enough behavioral evidence to identify the failing activation layer.
known_information: The affected feature is Text Extractor on PowerToys 0.101.2362.
PowerToys is running non-elevated as a per-user install on Windows NT 10.0.26200.0 with zh-Hans-HK locale.
No comments, attachments, assignees, linked work, or duplicate-confirming maintainer activity are present.
inferences: The failure could be a global shortcut conflict, disabled or blocked module state, failure to launch PowerToys.PowerOCR.exe, or overlay startup failure.
Locale is probably incidental, but fresh logs are needed before ruling out OCR language or startup-resource issues.
issue_context.analysis: Text Extractor’s module interface registers a configured/default Win+Shift+T shortcut and starts PowerToys.PowerOCR.exe, while the app-level keyboard monitor opens the overlay. Without the configured shortcut and visible result, the issue cannot be mapped to shortcut registration versus process/overlay startup.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the complete live issue body, comments, labels, assignees, timeline, and closed-by-PR references.
Searched for candidate duplicates; results were generic Text Extractor shortcut/screen issues, not a direct match to this no-detail report.
Inspected the Text Extractor hotkey and overlay activation code paths in the local PowerToys clone.

information_gaps.information: The configured Text Extractor shortcut and exactly what appears when it is pressed.
information_gaps.why_needed: This identifies whether the shortcut is registered and whether activation starts before failing.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Include a screenshot of the Text Extractor shortcut setting and describe any notification, cursor change, selection overlay, or complete lack of response.

information_gaps.information: Whether Text Extractor starts from PowerToys Settings or another activation surface.
information_gaps.why_needed: This separates a global-hotkey conflict from Text Extractor process or overlay startup failure.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Enable Text Extractor, trigger it from Settings if available, and report whether the selection overlay appears.

information_gaps.information: Fresh PowerToys diagnostics captured immediately after reproducing.
information_gaps.why_needed: The logs can show shortcut registration conflicts, process launch failures, or overlay startup exceptions.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Immediately after reproducing, add a comment containing /bugreport and attach the generated ZIP.

comment.body: Thanks for reporting the Text Extractor shortcut problem. Please share a screenshot of the configured Text Extractor shortcut and describe exactly what happens when you press it, including whether there is no response, a notification, cursor change, or the selection overlay. Also confirm whether Text Extractor starts from PowerToys Settings or another activation surface. Immediately after reproducing the failure, please add a comment containing `/bugreport` and attach the generated ZIP. The activation comparison will separate a shortcut conflict from a module startup problem, and the fresh logs can identify the failing path.
